source: Department of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries of Preah Vihear Province (មន្ទីរកសិកម្ម រុក្ខាប្រមាញ់ និងនេសាទ ខេត្តព្រះវិហារ), presentation "ដំណើរការផលិតកម្មគ្រាប់ពូជស្រូវសុទ្ធ" (Process of Pure Rice Seed Production), presented by Ms. Yem Sokey (យឹម សុគី), Deputy Head of the Office of Agricultural Techniques and Agricultural Productivity, dated 20 November 2017. Contact: ysophy168@gmail.com, 012 558 312.
text:
The purpose of training farmers to produce their own pure (clean, true-to-variety) rice seed is twofold: first, so that farmers know how to produce pure seed themselves, and second, so that farmers have enough pure seed available for their next planting season.

Using seed that is not clean or not pure (mixed with off-types, weed seed, or other varieties) carries several disadvantages for farmers: (1) impure seed cannot be reused for further seed multiplication/extension; (2) it causes yield or product loss of about 10-30%; (3) the milled rice and grain quality is poor, so it sells at a lower price; (4) more broken grains occur during milling; (5) cooked rice becomes hard quickly and loses its aroma; and (6) cooked sticky rice (glutinous rice) is not tasty, spoils quickly, and develops an off smell. These are the main reasons farmers are encouraged to follow a proper pure-seed production process rather than saving seed indiscriminately from mixed harvests.
